title: Tighter CBCMAC Multi-Collision Probability Bound
summary: The Lemma 3 bound is known to be loose; derive a tighter CBCMAC multi-collision probability bound to improve the corresponding CTR-DRBG security term.

formal_statement.body: In the security analysis of $\mathrm{NIST\ CTR\mbox{-}DRBG}$, a term in the security bound arises from a $\mathrm{CBCMAC}$ multi-collision probability estimate that is known to be loose. Derive a tighter bound for this $\mathrm{CBCMAC}$ multi-collision probability and thereby improve the corresponding $\mathrm{CTR\mbox{-}DRBG}$ security bound.

scope.domain: Combinatorial probability and symmetric-cryptographic security analysis of CBCMAC multi-collisions in NIST CTR-DRBG.
parameters: qL, sigma, and n: quantities appearing in the CBCMAC-derived security-bound term
Four related variable-length messages: inputs to the joint collision probability bounded by Lemma 3
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive a tighter bound for the CBCMAC multi-collision probability and improve the corresponding term in the CTR-DRBG security bound.

progress.summary: The source identifies the relevant security-bound term as arising from a CBCMAC multi-collision analysis and describes the Lemma 3 bound as rather loose. It explicitly leaves improving that bound as an open problem.
citation_labels: Viet Tung Hoang et al., Security Analysis of NIST CTR-DRBG
